whenToUse: A sticky in-page table of contents for long pages: documentation, handbooks, CVs, policy pages, long articles.
Showing which section the reader is in while they scroll.
avoidWhen: Navigation between pages — use navigation-menu, sidebar or navbar.
Switching views in place without scrolling — use tabs.
Pages with only two or three short sections.
a11y: A nav landmark (named "On this page" by default or by the visible title) of plain #id links that work without JavaScript.
The current section's link gets aria-current="location"; the accent rule is decorative.
Clicking moves focus to the section and updates the URL hash; scrolling is instant under reduced motion or data-motion="off".
